column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong hit probability and benefits from a hitter-friendly park in Colorado, making him a steady and reliable option at the top of the order. Luis Arraez offers similar appeal with excellent consistency and a favorable platoon matchup, keeping his floor high. Jonathan Aranda and Junior Caminero also draw soft pitching but come with slightly less reliability. Jeremy Pena’s steady track record keeps him in play, though the matchup is less favorable.
